TABLE_MODE.Controls.Title: Table Mode
TABLE_MODE.Controls.ToggleViewbox: Toggle Viewbox (drag to move, bottom-right handle to resize)
TABLE_MODE.Settings.VttUser.Name: VTT User
TABLE_MODE.Settings.VttUser.Hint: The Foundry user whose client renders on the table TV. Viewport commands are sent to this user. GM accounts are excluded; Assistant GM is allowed.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.VttAspect.Name: VTT Screen Aspect Ratio
TABLE_MODE.Settings.VttAspect.Hint: Locks the viewbox to this aspect ratio. Use 'Auto' to detect the VTT client's actual screen. Override if auto-detection gives wrong results (e.g., VTT tab has a sidebar open).
TABLE_MODE.Settings.AnimationDuration.Hi: Duration of the pan/zoom animation when the VTT client receives a viewport sync.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.NoVttUser: Table Mode: no VTT user selected. Set one in module settings first.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.Synced: Table Mode: viewport synced to VTT.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.ReloadSent: Table Mode: reload command sent to VTT client.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideSidebar.Name: Hide VTT Sidebar
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideSidebar.Hint: Hides the entire right-hand sidebar (chat, combat, scenes tabs) on the VTT client.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideChat.Name: Hide VTT Chat
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideChat.Hint: Hides the chat log and chat input. Use if keeping the sidebar but not chat.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideNavigation.Name: Hide VTT Scene Navigation
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideNavigation.Hint: Hides the top scene-tabs bar on the VTT client.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HidePlayers.Name: Hide VTT Player List
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HidePlayers.Hint: Hides the player-presence list (bottom-left) on the VTT client.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideHotbar.Name: Hide VTT Hotbar
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideHotbar.Hint: Hides the macro hotbar at the bottom of the VTT screen.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideControls.Name: Hide VTT Scene Controls
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideControls.Hint: Hides the left-hand scene controls toolbar on the VTT client.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideLogo.Name: Hide VTT Foundry Logo
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideLogo.Hint: Hides the Foundry logo on the VTT client.
